name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.75.0 — reports write the queue instead of narrating deferred work in prose (specs/20260903/04-reports-write-the-queue.md): `report-render.js` gains an optional `queued: [string]` slot, rendered `📋 {text}` between `found` and `next` (`📋` joins `ANCHOR_GLYPHS`; an empty/absent array renders nothing, byte-identical to today). core.md § Console Output Style's Close the loop bullet now requires every deferred action — anything a report would tell the user to do later, or a new spec/brief judged to run before the current work — to be written via `spec-queue add …` before rendering (`--top` urgent, `--after-spec`/`--after-brief` gated) and listed under `queued`, never left as a sentence; /spec:plan's Lock step 2, /spec:review's DONE report and Close step, and /spec:escape's step 7 each cite the rule at their own deferred-work site. tests/report/report-render.test.js. 7.74.0 — the session queue gains after-gates and spec items, and sheds the auto-placement veto (specs/20260903/03-pipeline-queue-mechanics.md): a third item kind `{kind:"spec"}` queues an ad-hoc spec by path with its own overlay position; any item may carry `{"after":{"spec"|"brief":…}}`, read by new `isItemReady()` in `lib/queue.js` and surfaced as an `after <target> (<state>)` blocker sinking the entry into the blocked tier; `reconcileMissingBriefs` now appends an on-disk brief last with no `auto_placed` stamp and no notice, and every write subcommand strips any `auto_placed` key it finds; `dedupeItems` collapses a brief/spec queued twice to its first occurrence, and `add` of an already-queued brief/spec exits 2 naming `move`. Verb set shrinks to `next`/`list`/`add`/`move`/`done`: `bump`, `defer`, `ok`, `add --after`, and `add --brief` are removed, each exiting 2 naming its replacement; `move <ref> <n>` and `add --at <n>` count pending positions exactly as the rewritten `list` render numbers them. The `queue-auto-placed` anomaly kind and its icon are deleted from spec-status.js. spec/commands/queue.md and spec/commands/status.md rewritten to match. tests/queue/spec-queue.test.js, tests/queue/queue-overlay.test.js, tests/spec-paths.test.js. 7.73.0 — the reviewer seat is Fable at `effort: low` (spec/agents/reviewer.md frontmatter; core.md § Model Placement rewritten: independence now includes a different model family from the Opus session that builds; the disposer inherits at `effort: medium`; every verdict-returning seat declares effort explicitly). Direct change, no spec, JJ-ratified 2026-09-03; measured passively by the per-close replay — revisit if the miss rate rises over the next ~20 specs. tests/review/reviewer-seat.test.js.
